scenes.alt: A comfortable shared indoor gathering area for the tour group.
The open courtyard of the Grand Mosque in Makkah, with space for quiet reflection.
A rocky stepped path ascending Jabal Nur above Makkah.
A resting point along the Jabal Nur climb, overlooking the surrounding hills and city.
The rocky slope and white summit marker of Jabal Rahmah on the plain of Arafat.
The courtyard of Masjidil Nabawi in Madinah beneath its great shade umbrellas.
A quiet prayer area inside Masjidil Nabawi, with distant worshippers and open carpet nearby.
Aleem and Nadiah pause together during the climb of Jabal Nur, talking about their lives.
Aleem and Nadiah find themselves together again on Jabal Rahmah, standing at a respectful distance.
Aleem sits in private prayer inside Masjidil Nabawi, his shoulders easing as he breathes out.
